The top 10 players by total points in the 2011 NBA season are:

1. Kevin Durant - 2161 points
2. LeBron James - 2111 points
3. Kobe Bryant - 1970 points
4. Kevin Love - 1831 points
5. Russell Westbrook - 1668 points
6. Dwyane Wade - 1597 points
7. Dirk Nowitzki - 1590 points
8. Blake Griffin - 1544 points
9. Amar'e Stoudemire - 1495 points
10. Monta Ellis - 1486 points

The top 5 players by assists in the 2011 NBA season are:

1. Steve Nash - 820 assists
2. Rajon Rondo - 720 assists
3. Chris Paul - 668 assists
4. Deron Williams - 664 assists
5. Jose Calderon - 622 assists

Finish
